title: nominationResponseTimeSeries
description: Time series for one nomination response quantity type. Values must be ordered by ascending timestamp.

quantityType.description: Type of quantity represented by the nomination response time series.

x-enumDescriptions.InternallyProcessedQuantity: Quantity processed internally by the sender.
x-enumDescriptions.InternallyProcessedQuantityCounterpart: Quantity processed internally by the counterpart.
x-enumDescriptions.ConfirmedQuantity: Quantity confirmed after the nomination or matching process.
x-enumDescriptions.RequestedQuantity: Quantity originally requested by the BKV or matching partner.

values.description: Chronologically ordered hourly nomination response values. The interval duration is defined by nominationResponseData.granularity.

flowDirection.description: Direction of the processed or confirmed nomination quantity.

x-enumDescriptions.Entry: Flow into the relevant network, system or balancing group.
x-enumDescriptions.Exit: Flow out of the relevant network, system or balancing group.
